description: Civgraph source ledger: each source Civgraph holds or plans to hold, whether it is mirrored and where, what has been extracted from it, and what remains. Validated by npm run check:source-ledger; docs/source-ledger.md is generated from it.
policy: Published with the site, so it lists only sources whose content Civgraph may make public: open licences (OGL, OPL, Creative Commons, CC0, ODbL, Irish PSI open terms), Crown or state copyright that has expired, the public domain, and Civgraph's own or contributed work. Sources held or consulted under any other terms are tracked privately and are not listed here.

liveStores.measuredAt: 2026-11-09 (the three data/sources/ prefixes for EONI, the Electoral Commission and the Irish boundary reports added 2026-11-11)

sources.name: Electoral Office for Northern Ireland result sheets (incl. archived 1973-2005 sheets)

mirrored.approxSize: 414 objects, 0.18 GB on R2 (data/sources/eoni-result-sheets/): the 2022 Assembly, 2023 council and 2024 Westminster sheets on eoni.org.uk and 330 earlier sheets and booklets (1973-2021) from Internet Archive captures, with a manifest; a further set recovered from the Internet Archive on 11 Nov 2026 is held locally, awaiting upload

extracted.what: NI council, Assembly, Westminster and European results checked against the sheets; 1,735 Civgraph areas audited for a sheet; a full Internet Archive sweep of every EONI domain (11 Nov 2026) recovered the old site's 2007 Assembly result slides, 2011 Assembly and council result sheets, the Westminster results pages of 2010-2019, the 2019 council sheets of Belfast, Derry City and Strabane, Ards and North Down, Lisburn and Castlereagh and Newry, Mourne and Down, and 1985-2007 by-election results; clear transcription errors recorded as source-checked fixes, and 161 contests compared figure by figure (web-checked batch eoni-ia-2026-11-11)

sources.remaining: 61 figures where the sheets and Civgraph disagree await a decision; Assembly 1998 and 2003, Forum 1996 and European 1979-1999 are rotated scans not yet compared; of the sheets recovered on 11 Nov 2026, 58 of the 2011 council sheets (most of them scans), 19 scanned 2019 council sheets (Derry City and Strabane, Lisburn and Castlereagh, Newry, Mourne and Down) and 7 of the 2007 Assembly slides still need checking by eye, and the by-election results are not yet compared. For Westminster 2010-2019 EONI published results pages, not sheets.
sources.nextStep: Mirror the 11 Nov 2026 Internet Archive set to R2, then check the scanned 2011 and 2019 council sheets by eye.

sources.name: Electoral Commission (UK) results and reports

extracted.what: Results spreadsheets compared with NI contests; clear transcription errors recorded as source-checked fixes

sources.remaining: The Commission's web pages answer automated requests with a browser challenge, so files were taken from direct links or archive captures; 27 figures where its spreadsheets and Civgraph disagree await a decision.
sources.nextStep: Settle the 27 disagreements against the Electoral Office sheets.

sources.name: The Gazette (Belfast and London editions): election and boundary notices

mirrored.approxSize: every Belfast Gazette issue 1921-2026 read through its text layer (held locally, cited by issue and page)

extracted.what: Lists of members returned to Stormont and Westminster checked against contests and cited on them; boundary orders listed

sources.remaining: The Gazette prints no council election returns, nominations or results, so it cannot fill council gaps: council members appear only when a later notice styles them Councillor or Alderman, which corroborates a membership but names no election.
sources.nextStep: Use the Gazette's ward orders and election-postponement orders as dated citations on the council rounds they governed.
